text: For seed 23 on data_seed 0, the same-layer N=64 minus N=128 force gap is about 0.074 at 12000 steps (0.7935 vs about 0.720) but only 0.040 at 24000 steps. Is that shrink driven almost entirely by N=64 losing force under the longer schedule, rather than by N=128 gaining? If so, should ceiling tests compare the two arms at matched schedule fraction instead of at endpoints?
